create_flow_matching_interpolant: create a FlowMatchingInterpolant instance with custom min_t, num_timesteps, and self_condition settings
corrupt_batch_for_training: corrupt a batch of clean data by interpolating to noisy samples for flow matching training
sample_with_denoiser: sample new data from random noise using a denoiser model and Euler integration steps
sample_with_cfg: sample new data using classifier-free guidance with a configurable cfg_scale for DiT denoisers
generate_centered_gaussian_noise: generate centered Gaussian noise for a given batch size, token count, and embedding dimension
